invariants.rationale: The cached flag is always set to true by the first-time branch and never set to false.
spriteCache is accessed unconditionally, so it must be non-null.
map is dereferenced multiple times, so it must be non-null.
The method calls map.getLayers() repeatedly, safely, so the result must be non-null.
spriteCache.end() is always called before return, so drawing should have ended.
